payload.content:
=== Dockerfile ===
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY src ./src
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node", "src/server.js"]


=== compose.yaml ===
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "18081:8080"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=development
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:example@db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    labels:
      - "gordon-experiment=prompt-framework"

  web:
    image: node:22-alpine
    working_dir: /web
    command: sh -c "npm install && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
    volumes:
      - ./web:/web
    ports:
      - "18082:5173"
    labels:
      - "gordon-experiment=prompt-framework"

  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=app
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=example
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
    volumes:
      - ./db/migrations:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app -d app"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    labels:
      - "gordon-experiment=prompt-framework"


=== package.json ===
{
  "name": "gordon-prompt-framework-fixture-api",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node src/server.js",
    "test": "node src/server.js --check",
    "lint": "node -e \"console.log('lint placeholder')\""
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^5.0.0"
  }
}
